basis: Immune hypersensitivity to insect venom; transient skin or systemic allergic reactions do not establish lasting organ damage.
Defective neutrophil adhesion causes immunodeficiency; destructive periodontitis is common (>30%). Skin ulcers reported in 5/19 fall below threshold.
Carcinoma arising in the epithelial lining of the cecum.
Defective vitamin D activation causes hypocalcemia and skeletal rickets; phosphate wasting reflects hormonal disturbance rather than intrinsic kidney damage.
Eating disorder, explicitly outside the organ axes; associated medical complications are not defining organ disease.
Renal hypoplasia and alopecia define syndrome; severe developmental delay and contractures 4/4; hepatic steatosis 3/4 and eyelid hypoplasia 4/4 omitted by cap.
Defined by skeletal muscular dystrophy and cerebral white-matter disease.
Tumor originates in renal cortical epithelium; usually localized.
Defined immunodeficiency, myopathy and ectodermal dysplasia; autoimmune thrombocytopenia 3/3. Enamel defects and iris hypoplasia, each 3/3, omitted by cap.
Localized corneal amyloid deposition causes corneal opacity and substantial visual impairment.
Immunoglobulin heavy/light-chain amyloid deposition disorder; clinically significant renal involvement occurs in most reported cases (>80%).
Cerebellar and caudate degeneration; hearing impairment in 2/2 assessed. Isolated ocular and skeletal findings lack established >=30% disease-related prevalence.
Autoinflammatory panniculitis; inflammatory joint swelling 3/3 and vasculitis 1/3 (~33%, small series). Diarrhea alone does not establish bowel damage.
Autoimmune disease; arthritis ~80%, cutaneous disease ~70%, renal inflammation ~40-60% and major criterion. Hematologic and oral manifestations omitted by cap.
Defined by progressive cerebral white-matter degeneration and congenital or early-onset sensorineural deafness; visual involvement frequency unspecified.
Diffuse neoplastic overgrowth of adipose tissue, usually subcutaneous; internal-organ involvement varies by subtype.
Persistent neurodevelopmental impairment; no additional organ damage applies consistently across this umbrella.
Inborn energy-metabolism defect; developmental impairment 80-99%; hepatic disease is a major phenotype, with hepatic encephalopathy 30-79%. Cardiomyopathy <30%.
Parasitic infestation of scalp skin and hair by head lice.
Primary antibody immunodeficiency; recurrent infections and separately diagnosed bronchiectasis do not establish additional intrinsic organ involvement.
Ovarian sex cord-stromal tumor of hormone-producing Sertoli/Leydig cells; gonadal endocrine tissue falls within the endocrine axis.
Fusion-defined mesenchymal sarcoma arising predominantly in bone, with some soft-tissue primaries.
Inherited red-cell membrane disorder causing elliptocytosis and variable hemolysis; jaundice does not establish liver damage.
Cutaneous adnexal carcinoma arising from eccrine sweat glands.
Biochemical enzyme elevation; no pancreatic or salivary damage is established. Circulating amylase elevation alone is not a blood-cell or coagulation disorder.
